title: Black Widow night fighters redeployed to patrol around Roswell

tellings.quote: what I found out was that we had a night fighter during World War II called the Black Widow.

plain: A researcher, John Brandenburg, told podcast host Jesse Michels about something he says he found while looking into Roswell, a town in New Mexico where, according to many people, something strange crashed in 1947. Brandenburg says that the military moved Black Widows, a night fighter plane from World War II, to patrol the skies around Roswell, and he points to a source called Cosmic Awakening. If true, it would suggest the military was guarding the area against something in the air.
